title: Houthis Claim Missile Strike on Riyadh Airport; Airlines Suspend Flights
detail: Houthi forces claimed a missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, with explosions reported across the Saudi capital. Multiple airlines suspended flights to Riyadh in response, marking a significant escalation of Houthi cross-border attacks on Saudi infrastructure.

title: UN, UK and Arab States Issue Joint Condemnation of Houthi Attacks on Saudi Airports
detail: The United Nations, United Kingdom, and multiple Arab states issued a joint condemnation of Houthi drone and missile attacks targeting Saudi airports, calling on Houthi forces to halt cross-border strikes on civilian infrastructure and urging de-escalation.

title: Saudi Arabia Confirms 3 Killed in Houthi Riyadh Airport Strike; Airport Reopens
detail: Saudi Arabia officially confirmed that three Saudi citizens were killed in Houthi missile strikes on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh. The airport briefly closed following the attack but has since reopened. Separately, Pakistan clarified that its troops stationed in Saudi Arabia are not participating in any operations against the Houthis.

media.caption: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh reopens after Houthi missile strike killed three

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Launches Wide-Scale Military Operations Against Houthi Targets Across Yemen
detail: The Saudi-led coalition conducted wide-scale military operations against Houthi targets across Yemen in direct response to the Houthi missile strikes on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport. The operations marked a significant escalation in coalition military activity following the Houthis' cross-border strikes on Saudi civilian infrastructure.

title: Saudi Arabia and Yemeni Government Call on UN to Take Firm Action Against Houthis
detail: Saudi Arabia and the internationally recognised Yemeni government jointly called on the United Nations to take firm action against the Houthis following the missile strikes on Saudi airports. The joint statement urged the Security Council to hold the Houthis accountable for attacks on civilian aviation infrastructure and to impose stronger measures to deter further escalation.

title: UN Special Envoy Warns Yemen Has Returned to Full-Scale War, Urges Dialogue
detail: The UN special envoy for Yemen warned that the country has returned to full-scale war following the Houthi strikes on Saudi airports and the subsequent coalition military operations. The envoy urgently called on all parties to return to dialogue and negotiations, cautioning that continued escalation risks undoing fragile peace efforts and could trigger a wider regional conflict.
